load_library_custom_classes: load a shared library to register custom classes with the PyTorch JIT runtime
inspect_loaded_libraries: inspect the set of paths for all shared libraries loaded via torch.classes
access_class_namespace: access a custom class namespace under torch.classes by attribute name
get_custom_class_proxy: get a Python proxy wrapper for a registered custom JIT class
raise_class_not_found: raise a RuntimeError when a requested custom class is not registered
